name: lagu-music-player
description: Lagu Music Player - a minimalist local desktop music player

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist: npm run fetch:ytdlp && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: npm run fetch:ytdlp && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run fetch:ytdlp -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch:ytdlp -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run fetch:ytdlp -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:all: npm run fetch:ytdlp && npm run fetch:ytdlp -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run fetch:ytdlp -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run fetch:ytdlp -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder -mwl
